role: Independent reference reader; descriptive specification only

inspection_scope.evidence_policy: Visible facts derive from direct image inspection. Physical dimensions and text size derive exclusively from the request. Palette and relative geometry are visual estimates, not recovered author settings. Data semantics and record counts derive from the request and dictionary.

target.chart_type: Five-spoke radar chart with circular radial grid
target.requested_region: The kBET acceptance-rate chart under the central depot heading in Figure 1e

mapping.angle: Five cell classes; shared cell-class direction key specifies their positions
mapping.marks: Colored circular point markers joined by straight colored segments into closed five-vertex traces

axes.radial_tick_label_position: At or just left of the top vertical spoke
axes.radial_scale_appearance: Increasing outwards; labelled rings and positions are consistent with a linear scale
axes.grid: Circular rings, with fine gray spokes; the intermediate ring is blue-teal and dashed, and the outer ring is pale gray and dashed
axes.cell_class_labels_on_requested_chart: Absent in the original chart; the bottom shared direction key supplies them

layers_back_to_front: White page background and a very pale gray circular plot area
Thin spokes and dashed circular radial grid
Filled circular point markers at the five vertices of each trace
Black radial tick labels and chart labels
visible_facts.fills: No colored filled areas inside method polygons are visible

labels.reference_method_legend: Line segment plus circular marker for each method, positioned below the six-chart figure
labels.reference_cell_class_key: Small five-arrow direction diagram at bottom right, labelled all, FAPs, vascular, immune, adipocytes
labels.significance_annotation: No asterisk is visible on the requested depot kBET chart; the asterisk in the left-hand method chart is outside scope

relative_geometry.plot_shape: Circular radar area, approximately as wide as tall
relative_geometry.reference_target_location: Left chart of the central two-chart depot group
relative_geometry.reference_group_frame: Thin rectangular outline jointly encloses the depot kBET and ARI charts, with a gap in its top border for the depot title

palette.confidence: High for qualitative hues; hex values are visual estimates

relative_geometry.ring_radius_ratio: The labelled 0.25 circle appears a little more than half the radius of the 0.5 circle
relative_geometry.radial_origin_caveat: A small central offset or padding might have been used; the exact radial minimum, origin transform, and border padding cannot be established from the image alone
relative_geometry.confidence: Moderate; no physical sizes may be inferred from crop pixels

trace_appearance_cross_checks: scVI reaches furthest outward at the lower-right vascular spoke and has a relatively high top all value
Harmony extends outward most at the upper-right FAPs spoke
Several traces lie close to the center at the upper-left adipocytes spoke
raw extends further outward toward lower-right vascular than its near-central top all point
These are qualitative visual checks, not numeric substitutes for supplied rates
visual_estimates_not_hard_facts.overlap_order: Some markers obscure others near the center; the exact method drawing order is not recoverable with confidence

unknown_statistical_choices: No new statistical calculation is needed: all acceptance rates are supplied
Underlying kBET settings and biological analysis choices are not recoverable from this image and are outside the requested visualization task
No error bars, confidence intervals, replicate counts, or uncertainty estimates are supplied or visible; do not invent them
unknown_visualization_choices: Exact radial minimum and any intentional offset below zero
Exact RGB colors, line widths, marker sizes, font metrics, and plotting margins
Method rendering order at overlapping vertices
Whether the circular background and outer ring were implemented as axes properties or separate graphical elements

adopted_requested_modifications.assembly: Extract the central depot kBET chart into one standalone chart
adopted_requested_modifications.typeface: Arial; document an available fallback if Arial is unavailable
adopted_requested_modifications.canvas_preservation: Retain full requested physical canvas; do not crop output to content
adopted_requested_modifications.method_coverage: All five methods must be represented and identifiable
adopted_requested_modifications.class_coverage: All five cell classes must be represented, with a readable direction key or direct spoke labels
adopted_requested_modifications.data_usage: Display all 25 supplied acceptance rates without recomputing integration or kBET
adopted_requested_modifications.layout_principle: Keep the cell-class orientation, method-color mapping, radar geometry, and rate labels readable within the requested physical canvas; original whole-figure shared legend placement need not be copied

required_data_semantics.grain: One already-computed acceptance rate per integration-method and cell-class pair
required_data_semantics.integration_method: Original source group label, mapped to publication label
required_data_semantics.cell_class: Original source column label, mapped to publication label and angular position

acceptance_rate.zero_semantics: Zero is a valid measured value, not missingness
acceptance_rate.missingness: Dictionary states all 25 values are present
acceptance_rate.data_vs_display_domain: The valid measure domain [0,1] is distinct from the reference chart's outer labelled ring at 0.5; confirm supplied extrema when setting final display limits

required_data_semantics.source_provenance: KBET_D worksheet of Figure_1e.xlsx, cells A1:F6; D denotes depot comparison; reshaped but not rescaled or recomputed
required_data_semantics.attribution: Request attributes the image and released source data to Massier et al., Nature Communications 14, 1438 (2023), DOI 10.1038/s41467-023-36983-2, CC BY 4.0
